title: Local eventual vanishing of raw higher-image cohomology classes
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], I a nonempty directed preorder, D : Iᵒᵖ → Over S a system with affine transitions and qcqs structure maps, and c a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting and whose structure map is qcqs. Let F_i be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] with unital compatible inverse-image maps φ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let H, eH, hH present the pulled-back coefficient diagram on the limit, with colimit F. Fix p ≥ 0, an etale U over S, i, and a raw class z in Hom((g_i⁻¹ ℤ[U])[0], F_i[0][p]) [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Suppose its canonical derived pullback with the coefficient coprojection becomes zero after the sheafification unit [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the limit raw presheaf. Then there is a covering sieve R on U such that every q : W → U in R admits a stage j and f : i → j for which the raw pullback of z restricted to W is zero. The raw pullback is the explicitly constructed single/composition/shift/coefficient map from [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison]. No common stage for the whole sieve is asserted.

source.place: Tags 09Z1, 03Q8 and 0EZM; local injectivity followed by affine cohomology continuity

proof.text: For the raw limit image t, local injectivity of the sheafification unit makes its equalizer sieve with zero covering (Mathlib Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem). Define R to consist of arrows admitting a later stage that kills the class after every further restriction. Associativity of composition proves R is a sieve.

For each arrow q : W → U in the equalizer sieve, test R.pullback q on affine objects V → W. The limit raw image restricts to zero there by the presheaf composition law. Apply affine restriction vanishing to obtain a stage killing all further restrictions; this is precisely membership in R.pullback q. The affine open cover of W is a jointly surjective etale cover (Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff), so R.pullback q is covering.

Grothendieck-topology transitivity makes R covering. On each arrow in R, evaluate the universal further-restriction assertion at its identity to get the eventual-zero witness required by the unchanged statement.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09Z1 and 03Q8: local sheafification and affine cover gluing, formalized by R1

theorem exists_higherDirectImage_raw_local_class_eq_zero {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S)
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f).left]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget S).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (((D.map f.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hφid : ∀ i : I, HEq (φ (𝟙 i))
      ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj (op i)).left).hom.app (F i)))
    (hφcomp : ∀ {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), HEq (φ (f ≫ g))
      ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map g.op).left
          (D.map f.op).left).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((D.map g.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ φ g))
    (H : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅
      (((c.π.app (op i)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i))
    (hH : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c.π.app (op j)).left (D.map f.op).left
          (c.π.app (op i)).left
          (congrArg (fun t => t.left) (c.w f.op)).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((c.π.app (op j)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    [HasColimit H] (p : ℕ) (U : S.Etale) (i : I)
    (z : (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf (D.obj (op i)).hom p (F i)).obj (op U))
    (hz : (toSheafify S.smallEtaleTopology
      (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf c.pt.hom p (colimit H))).app (op U)
        (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback (c.π.app (op i)).left
          (D.obj (op i)).hom c.pt.hom (Over.w (c.π.app (op i))) p (F i)
          (colimit H) ((eH i).inv ≫ colimit.ι H i) U z) = 0) :
    ∃ R : Sieve U, R ∈ S.smallEtaleTopology U ∧
      ∀ (W : S.Etale) (q : W ⟶ U), R q →
        ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
          abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback (D.map f.op).left (D.obj (op i)).hom
            (D.obj (op j)).hom (Over.w (D.map f.op)) p (F i) (F j) (φ f) W
              ((abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf (D.obj (op i)).hom p (F i)).map
                q.op z) = 0
